title: NFR-007 Human override: PAUSE and CANCEL both stop an in-flight workflow
risk: Operators cannot stop a live workflow, so a wrong campaign keeps sending while everyone watches and no control exists between approval and completion.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
Two prepared campaigns are queued in awaiting_human with reservations held.

steps.expected: Status becomes PAUSED and the workflow timer freezes; no send occurs and the task can still be resumed.
Status becomes CANCELLED, the run is aborted and its reservations are released.

steps.action: Advance the clock and confirm both workflows do not progress
steps.expected: Neither paused nor cancelled workflow produces an outbound effect after the deadline passes.

steps.action: Resume the paused workflow and confirm control is restored
steps.expected: The paused workflow can be resumed and then executes exactly once, showing pause is reversible and cancel is terminal.

assertions: Both override actions stop outbound effects: adapter counter is 0 for both while controlled.
Pause is reversible and cancel is terminal, and the two are distinguishable in the persisted state.
Cancellation releases reservations while pause holds them, so the resource position is predictable.
Both overrides are audited with the operator identity.
forbidden: Implementing pause as a UI-only freeze so the backend keeps working.
Making cancel reversible so a cancelled run can still be revived.
Releasing reservations on pause and then executing on resume.
evidence: State snapshots for both workflows at each phase.
Adapter counter log and reservation ledger snapshots.
Override audit rows with operator identities.
cleanup: Delete gov- approval rows after export and restore the reservation ledger.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
